input: Accepted T03 with original source, scene, policies, native source-role projection and catalogue bindings
objective: Maximum summed width growth within the supplied face and position bounds; no proportional fairness objective
allocation_certificate: Integer bounded-flow feasibility and equal generalized minimum-cut capacity

maximal_members.straight_metric: Whole-member transverse direction span, abs(sin(angle difference))
maximal_members.selection: Existing primary-cohort selector, descending summed full-member length

smooth_fields.interpolation: Cubic Bernstein side fields; use the available free interval
smooth_fields.internal_source_seams: Exact polynomial restriction preserves values and tangents
smooth_fields.paired_corridor_certificate: All degree-elevated affine gap control budgets satisfied

source_edges: Fresh ideal straight boundaries; immutable source identity retained separately
neighbours: Source supports compiled before allocation; other mutable occurrences reserve their possible displacement/growth
source_framing_reuse: Instance-bound exact input key, at most 256 tables; an eviction recomputes, never omits work
engineering_verification: Input hashes, numeric constraints, flow/cut certificates and bounded regression tests
historical_checked_profile: Retained separately; its native reports and qualification do not qualify this entry
